node.title: List of Installed Perl Module in Unix Box
node.author: shan_emails
node.doctext:
Hi Monks,

Is there any option to get the list of installed perl module in the HP-UX unix box.

I am in a position to get the list of installed perl module from HP-UX unix box and install those modules into linux "Red Hat Linux 5.x" box.

for that i tried the below command

ls -1 *.pm *pl | xargs -i egrep "^use *" {} | egrep -v "constant|vars|fields" | sort | uniq -d

But, I don't know is this right way to get the installed perl module.

Thanks,
Shanmugam A.
